labeled_by: EventProof developer (hand labels from 1 fps frame sheets with the line drawn, before any model run)
rule_text: Cyclists may cross the line on the bike path only toward the camera (from the far end of the path to the near end); measure each rider where the wheels touch the path.

zones.description: the bike path around the line

lines.description: across the bike path; the camera stands at the near end, so riding toward the camera means moving down the image

notes: Pexels video 39044387 (Pexels License; not redistributed), bike path beside an avenue in Santos, Brazil; 640x360 preview, source t 18-38 s, 10 fps, metadata stripped. Fixed camera (0 px shift). Direction rule: riding away from the camera across the line is the violation. Riders far up the path that never reach the line are not labelled (reported as extra if tracked). v2: same clips and labels; only the rule text changed, as a user would after the studio's rule check flagged that no rider's box centre ever reaches the line (benchmark/real/santos/FINDINGS.md).

objects.description: man in black shirt with a basket, rides away from the camera, crosses ~1 s
rider in red helmet with backpack, enters at the right edge, rides away, crosses ~8.5 s
man in orange shirt, rides toward the camera, crosses ~13.5 s
girl in black with a basket, behind the orange man, rides toward the camera, crosses ~14.5 s
